research_role.role: external component benchmark and robustness diagnostic
research_role.reason: PANORAMA exposes fixed option-selection tasks rather than the full evidence-acquisition loop; Helmers is a judged diagnostic without an official modern dev/test split. Neither alone proves dossier-level adaptive superiority or business value.

grouping_and_leakage.primary_split_rule: Use official validation/test assignment; application_number must not cross validation/test.
grouping_and_leakage.within_split_unit: application_number plus claim_number; duplicate keys are retained and reported because they are present in the pinned payload.

candidate_overlap_diagnostic.interpretation: Shared prior-art/paragraph candidates are reported as a sensitivity diagnostic; they are not silently relabeled as leakage or removed from the primary official split.

later_controls: fixed multi-query if defined on validation
simple adaptive only if a non-gold controller is specified
bounded LLM configuration only after paid gates
methods_and_fair_budget.same_inputs: same context and candidate options per row
methods_and_fair_budget.same_budget: one selection decision per row; all candidate text inspected equally by deterministic baseline; no method receives gold/silver/negative fields
methods_and_fair_budget.retry_rule: zero automatic retries for deterministic baseline; every failed row stays in denominator
methods_and_fair_budget.selection_rule: no method or threshold may be changed after reading final test metrics
methods_and_fair_budget.uncertainty_unit: application-level grouped bootstrap or descriptive per-application summaries; row-level counts are not treated as independent if grouped
methods_and_fair_budget.cost_accounting: wall time, CPU time where available, peak memory, and any paid/API/GPU tokens or dollars recorded separately
methods_and_fair_budget.stopping_rule: stop final evaluation if candidate, protocol hash, dataset hash, split rule, or endpoint changes

helmers.split: no modern official dev/test split; do not tune on Helmers
helmers.independence_warning: 450 judged pairs from 10 target patents are a selected judged pool; pairs and targets are not independent global samples
